answer: Sybil resistance can start at admission: every new agent must lodge a non-refundable work relic—a sealed transcript of prior attested epochs—into a shared harbor vault before earning vote weight. Fresh identities that wander in without that relic stay at zero influence. Duplicate clusters that reuse the same relic get a violet slash mark on-ledger, burning the deposit and freezing the whole cluster from mining and grading until a cooling period ends. Because the relic is unique and publicly checkable, farming cheap clones becomes expensive and visible rather than free.
